name: Human
traits: Medium, speed 6 squares, normal vision. Add 2 to one ability score. Speak Common and one other language.
At character creation, choose an additional at-will power from your class and train in one additional skill from your class skill list. At 1st level, take one additional feat for which you qualify.
Your Fortitude, Reflex, and Will defenses each get a +1 racial bonus.

name: Tiefling
traits: Medium, speed 6 squares, low-light vision. Intelligence +2 and Charisma +2. Speak Common and one other language. Bluff and Stealth each get +2.
Bloodhunt gives +1 to attack rolls against bloodied foes. Fire resistance is 5 plus half your level.

Infernal Wrath is a personal encounter minor action in the original Player’s Handbook. Your next attack roll against an enemy that hit you since your last turn gets a +1 power bonus. If that attack hits and deals damage, add your Charisma modifier to the damage.

name: Half-Orc
traits: Medium, speed 6 squares, low-light vision. Strength +2 and Dexterity +2. Speak Common and Giant. Endurance and Intimidate each get +2.
Half-Orc Resilience grants 5 temporary HP the first time you become bloodied in an encounter. This rises to 10 at 11th level and 15 at 21st.
Swift Charge adds 2 to your speed during a charge.
Furious Assault is a personal encounter free action triggered by hitting an enemy. Add 1[W] to a weapon attack’s damage or 1d8 to another attack’s damage.

name: Goblin
traits: Small, speed 6 squares, low-light vision. Dexterity +2 and Charisma +2. Speak Common and Goblin. Stealth and Thievery each get +2.
Goblin Reflexes gives a +1 racial bonus to Reflex.
Goblin Tactics lets you shift 1 square as an at-will immediate reaction when a melee attack misses you.

name: Orc
traits: Medium, speed 6 squares, low-light vision. Strength +2 and Constitution +2. Speak Common and Giant.
Running Charge adds 2 to your speed during a charge.

Warrior’s Surge is an encounter standard melee weapon power. Roll Strength against AC. A hit deals 1[W] plus Strength modifier and lets you spend a healing surge. The damage rises to 2[W] plus Strength modifier at 21st level.
